title: Grateful Dead Live at Madison Square Garden on 1982-09-21

ai_review.summary: Crystal‑clear soundboard capture of a smoking 1982 Garden show, highlighted by an epic Crazy Fingers and tight first‑set flow.
ai_review.review: The performance is widely praised as one of the year’s best, with a stellar opening four‑song run and a “smoking” Crazy Fingers that many call the post‑revival benchmark. The soundboard source is generally clear and lively, though a few listeners note it runs slightly fast and the mix can be a bit ragged or low on Jerry’s vocals.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers give 4‑5 stars, highlighting strong playing and clear audio; only occasional complaints about pitch/speed and mix balance keep the rating just above a solid four.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crystal‑clear overall with excellent detail, but some users report the playback is slightly fast (pitch up) and Jerry’s vocals sound thin; occasional ragged mix and a low‑level Jerry guitar in parts.

standout_songs: China Cat Sunflower > I Know You Rider
show_quality.setlist_flow: Strong, tight first‑set opening with the first four songs praised as a great sequence; the rest of the show maintains solid energy and an oddball but fun vibe.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Praised for his guitar work on Crazy Fingers, though some note his vocals sound high‑pitched due to speed issues and his mix can be low in places.
band_member_comments.Keys: Brent (keyboard) is highlighted for actually playing piano during the post‑revival Crazy Fingers segment.
